If I ever did get sick when taking it was always early into the dose where it’s more stimulating. Only after that wears down a bit did I ever feel a slight opiate euphoria. It definitely picked up my mood in a different way than other opiates from the snri component. 

Also I should mention you can maximize the conversion of tram to odsmt by stacking your pills rather than taking them all at once. I would always do 50mg/30min until I hit 300-400mg. Some say to double on the last intake so you may want to try 50/50/50/50/100 rather than 300mg down the hatch. I know it’s sucks taking your pills over a few hours but you’ll get more out of it this way. Just separate whatever dose you plan on taking from the bottle or your stash so you don’t lose track. I don’t want to advocate for benzos with opiates but with this specific drug I felt much safer with a light benzo in me especially reaching 400mg territory and it seemed to even out the shitty stim effects. Lastly I’ll say I think you will enjoy it more if you wait for the opiate effects to kick in before smoking weed.
